title: Manual automation not changing profile %
symptom: Manual automation sets profile to 30% and TT to 150. The TT works but the profile % doesn't change. Manually changing profile % also fails with an error message, but changing both profile and profile % works. The issue resolved itself the next morning.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One commenter suggests the basal rate might be below the pump's minimum, but the reporter notes the same error at 50% and the issue disappeared without explanation.
fix: No fix is stated. The issue resolved itself; the reporter notes it is working normally the next morning.
evidence_quote: Very strange, it's working normally this morning...
